name: Downtown Devil
source:
You've just met the perfect model for your photography business. Hot and wild, Mica is all the excitement you've been craving. But throw Vaughan--his sexy, sophisticated roommate--into the mix and you've got a storm of passion you never saw coming. Are you ready to have a threesome with a bad boy and his strong, sexy roommate?

[From in-app]
